title: helianthemum polifolium var. tomentellum
intro: Helianthemum polifolium var. tomentellum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species within the family Cistaceae. It is a shrubby perennial with attractive pink flowers and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Rockrose include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects, which can be attributed to its ability to relieve pain, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, such as kaempferol and quercetin, which exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
